sub_strands.name: Number Concept
performance_indicators: Count concrete objects forward and backward from 1 to 100.
Demonstrate place value of digits in numbers up to tens using bundles.
Read and write number symbols from 1 to 100 sequentially.

sub_strands.name: Whole Numbers and Operations
performance_indicators: Add a 2-digit number to a 1-digit number without regrouping up to a sum of 50.
Subtract a 1-digit number from a 2-digit number without regrouping up to 50.
Identify missing numbers in a simple arithmetic progression pattern up to 20.

sub_strands.name: Fractions
performance_indicators: Identify a half (1/2) as part of a whole using concrete cut-outs.
Combine two halves to make one whole object during mathematical play.

sub_strands.name: Length and Mass
performance_indicators: Measure lengths of classroom surfaces using non-standard units like hand spans and strides.
Compare the mass of distinct objects using non-standard balances or hand weight approximation.

sub_strands.name: Money and Time
performance_indicators: Identify Kenyan currency notes and coins up to a value of 100 Shillings.
Tell time using fixed markers on an analog clock face (such as 'O'clock').

sub_strands.name: Pronunciation and Vocabulary
performance_indicators: Pronounce vocabulary words containing common consonant-vowel-consonant (CVC) phonemes correctly.
Respond to complex, multi-step spoken instructions within the classroom environment.
Use basic courtesy words and conversational greetings appropriately during peer dialogue.

sub_strands.name: Word Recognition and Fluency
performance_indicators: Blend letter sounds together smoothly to read simple three-letter vocabulary words.
Recognize high-frequency sight words accurately within a brief reading passage.
Track text with a finger from left to right across a printed page smoothly.

sub_strands.name: Comprehension
performance_indicators: Answer explicit factual questions directly based on a short read-aloud story.
Predict what might happen next in an illustrated text using picture cues.

sub_strands.name: Handwriting and Transcription
performance_indicators: Form upper-case and lower-case letters legibly with appropriate spacing.
Spell frequently used vocabulary words accurately during dictation exercises.
Write simple personal sentences containing a subject and a verb independently.

sub_strands.name: Sauti na Msamiati
performance_indicators: Kutofautisha na kutamka sauti za herufi na silabi mbalimbali za Kiswahili ipasavyo.
Kutumia maamkizi na maneno ya adabu katika muktadha sahihi wa kijamii.
Kujibu maswali rahisi ya mdomo yanayohusu maisha ya kila siku nyumbani.

sub_strands.name: Kusoma kwa ufasaha
performance_indicators: Kusoma silabi na maneno mepesi yaliyoundwa kutokana na silabi hizo.
Kutambua alama za vituo na kusoma vifungu vifupi vya maneno kwa matamshi bora.
Kueleza ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi fupi iliyosomwa darasani.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa herufi na sentensi
performance_indicators: Kuandika herufi na silabi kwa miondoko sahihi na mwandiko nadhifu.
Kuunda na kuandika sentensi fupi za Kiswahili kwa kutumia msamiati ulioteuliwa.

sub_strands.name: Weather, Plants, and Soil
performance_indicators: Observe and record changes in local weather patterns over a specified duration.
Identify the basic parts of a plant (roots, stem, leaves) and describe their primary functions.
Demonstrate safe practices when exploring variations in local soil types.

sub_strands.name: Hygiene and Nutrition Practices
performance_indicators: Demonstrate proper personal hygiene, including correct body cleaning techniques.
Identify healthy and clean foods while sorting nutritious and non-nutritious options.
Practice safe and sanitary habits during meal preparation and consumption.

sub_strands.name: Our School and Community helpers
performance_indicators: Outline the location and roles of key administrative members within the school compound.
Describe the contributions of localized community helpers in ensuring safety and health.

sub_strands.name: Safety and Emergencies
performance_indicators: Differentiate between safe physical touches and inappropriate physical contact.
Identify hazard signs and demonstrate correct behaviors during simple emergency drills.

sub_strands.name: Visual Arts Expression
performance_indicators: Create two-dimensional drawings using lines and basic geometric shapes.
Produce patterns using primary colors through stamp-printing techniques.
Model basic animal shapes using clay, plasticine, or paper mâché.

sub_strands.name: Performance and Singing
performance_indicators: Sing patriotic and institutional anthems clearly with appropriate posture.
Perform rhythmic movements matching varying tempos in traditional audio tracks.

sub_strands.name: Movement and Coordination
performance_indicators: Demonstrate safe spatial awareness when running, skipping, or jumping.
Perform basic non-locomotor balances on various parts of the body.

sub_strands.name: God's Creation and Family
performance_indicators: Acknowledge human life as a sacred gift from God the Creator.
Demonstrate obedience and respect toward family elders and school authority.
Retell biblical stories that emphasize sharing, truthfulness, and love.

sub_strands.name: Iman, Quran and Hadith
performance_indicators: Recite specified short Surahs from the Holy Quran accurately.
Identify the essential attributes of Allah as revealed in Islamic foundational teachings.
Demonstrate standard Islamic etiquettes during meals and interactions with peers.

sub_strands.name: Core Moral Foundations
performance_indicators: Practice honesty and accountability during unsupervised peer play activities.
Show empathy and render assistance to peers with diverse physical needs.
Internalize positive behavior patterns through structural moral guidance sessions.
